intro.before: Every step in this story fixed one limit of the model before it:

events.name: LSTM
events.what: Gated memory cells that carry information across long sequences
events.why: Plain RNNs forgot after a few steps because their gradients vanished

events.name: word2vec
events.what: Dense word vectors learned from the words around each word
events.why: Similar words got nearby vectors, and offsets captured relations

events.name: Seq2seq
events.what: An encoder RNN squeezes a sentence into one vector; a decoder writes
events.why: Translation became one trainable network instead of a pipeline

events.name: Attention
events.what: The decoder looks back at every input word, weighted at each step
events.why: Removed the one-vector bottleneck that hurt long sentences

events.name: Transformer
events.what: Self-attention only: every token attends to every other token
events.why: No recurrence, so training runs in parallel and models can grow

events.name: GPT
events.what: A Transformer decoder pre-trained to predict the next token
events.why: One generative pre-trained model transferred to many tasks

events.name: BERT
events.what: A Transformer encoder pre-trained to fill in masked words
events.why: Fine-tuned BERT set new state-of-the-art results on 11 NLP tasks

events.name: GPT-3
events.what: 175B parameters, learning tasks from a few examples in the prompt
events.why: Prompting with examples began to replace fine-tuning for many tasks

themes.name: Longer memory
themes.note: gates, then attention over every word

themes.name: Richer word meaning
themes.note: from one-hot IDs to learned vectors

principles.sub: LSTMs fixed forgetting, attention fixed the single vector, Transformers fixed recurrence.
Self-attention trains every position at once, so very large models became practical.
Train once on raw text, then fine-tune or prompt instead of starting from scratch.

quote.big: Every fix revealed the next limit.
